```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(shiny)

# Styled datatable function
render_datatable <- function(data, digits = 2) {
  numeric_cols <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.numeric)]
  
  datatable(
    data,
    filter = "top",
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 12,
      lengthMenu = c(5, 10, 20, 50, 100),
      scrollX = TRUE,
      fixedHeader = TRUE,
      autoWidth = FALSE,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = list(
        list(
          extend = "csv",
          text = "Download CSV",
          filename = "County_Data"
        )
      ),
      columnDefs = list(
        list(width = '120px', targets = 0),
        list(width = '100px', targets = "_all")
      )
    ),
    rownames = FALSE
  ) %>%
    formatRound(columns = numeric_cols, digits = digits) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = names(data),
      `white-space` = 'normal',
      `word-break` = 'break-word',
      `font-size` = '13px'
    )
}

# Load data
file_path <- "C:/MRM/docs/other/xlsx/LandUseStat.xlsx"
counties <- excel_sheets(file_path)

data_all <- lapply(counties, function(cty) {
  df <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = cty)
  
  # SE data drop down
  section_names <- c("Population and Households", "Employment", "Students")
  df$Category <- ifelse(df[[1]] %in% section_names, df[[1]], NA)
  df <- fill(df, Category)
  
  df$County <- cty
  df
}) %>% bind_rows()

# UI elements
selectInput("county", "Select County:", choices = unique(data_all$County))

selectInput("category", "Select SE Data:",
            choices = unique(data_all$Category))

DTOutput("table")   

# Reactive table
output$table <- renderDT({  
  df <- data_all[
    data_all$County == input$county &
    data_all$Category == input$category,
  ]
  
  df$County <- NULL
  df$Category <- NULL
  
  num_cols <- sapply(df, is.numeric)
  
  df[num_cols] <- lapply(df[num_cols], function(x) {
    ifelse(
      is.na(x),
      NA,
      ifelse(x == floor(x),
             formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 0),
             formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2))
    )
  })
  
  render_datatable(df)
})
```
